evals.query: Audit the local agent customization system and fix any workflow gaps you find.
Implement a new activation function in the neural-network runtime.
Plan a new implementation phase, define acceptance criteria, and decide which specialists should run first.
Explain how sigmoid activation works in a neural network.
Research nearby source patterns and plan evidence before changing the checkpoint system.
Write the smallest failing test for this behavior change before implementation.
Make the scoped code changes using existing project patterns after the red test is in place.
The implementation is done; run the focused validators and route failures back to the right phase.
Update the JSDoc and generated README source inputs for this new public API.
Summarize the files changed, validation evidence, risks, and next handoff for this workstream.
Validate this .agent.md file and tell me if user-invocable or handoffs are wrong.
Add a recurrent connection to a NEAT genome and test the scheduler.
Check whether this SKILL.md has the right name, argument-hint, visibility flag, and local resource links.
Refine a skill description and argument hint without changing its trigger scope.
Create a hidden specialist agent for a narrow recurring validation job and wire it to 00-helping.
This custom agent has planning, implementation, and logging in one file; split it into orchestrator plus specialists.
Prepare a compact continuation summary with files changed, validators, and remaining risks.
Turn this vague feature request into observable acceptance criteria and non-goals.
Add a focused owner-local unit test that should fail before the bug fix.
Run the focused Jest command and summarize whether the targeted slice is green.
The validator failed; group the failures by owner and decide which are unrelated.
Audit this generated README input for missing examples, citations, and stale public API docs.
Update the JSDoc example and conceptual notes for this exported helper.
